title: LEMON CUSTARD THE FINEST E-JUICE 2X60ML
description:
The Finest’s Lemon Custard E-Juice is one of the most delectable dessert mixtures you’ll ever taste.
It all starts with a tasty portion of their rich, creamy, and velvety custard, which is then infused with bright lemons for perfect balance.
The end result is a beautifully multi-layered delight that is flawless in every way. Lemon Custard The Finest E-Juice 2x60ml is a must-try for any fan looking for a truly unique e-liquid combination.
Lemon Custard The Finest E-Juice 2x60ml Features and Specifications
:
• Bottle Size: 2 X 60ml
• Child Resistant Cap
• Nicotine Strength: 0 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg
• VG/PG Ratio: 70VG / 30PG
• Flavor Profile: Creamy Custard | Bright Lemons
• Made in the USA
